hints.title: Generate All Subarray Sums
hints.text: Given n <= 1000, the total count of non-empty continuous subarrays is n * (n + 1) / 2 <= 500500.

hints.title: Flatten and Sort
hints.text: Compute all subarray sums using nested loops, place them into an array, and sort them ascending.

hints.title: 1-Based Index Range Sum
hints.text: Sum elements from index left - 1 to right - 1 inclusive, taking modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct O(N^2) generation and sorting executes well within standard 2-second time limits for N <= 1000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating array of 500k integers takes ~4MB memory, which easily fits inside environment limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate performs modular arithmetic on the accumulated range sum.
complexity.notes: An O(N log(sum)) binary search approach also exists.
